svg.text: Right hand with cream shirt cuff

g.text: Thumb pad tightens toward the wrist.
Thumb and index hold the same corner.
Thumb and index pinch the chalk nub.
Index lines up. Other fingers curl in.
Index pad makes contact with the button.
Index bends as the wrist draws back.
Curled fingers approach below the rail.
Palm bears on the rail. Fingers stay close.
Palm clears the rail. Fingers curl in.
Fingers wrap over. Thumb hooks under.
